title: Great trail
text:
What a great adventure the Caminito del Ray! The trip from Granada was very comfortable. Our driver, Alberto, didn't speak much English but was very helpful and punctual. 
The natural scenery is amazing, and the trail itself is short but intense.
author: eduardodF542RM

title: Great experience!
text:
If you go to Granada or Malaga, do not hesitate to visit the Caminito del Rey. After almost 10 days in Spain enjoying churches, museums and bars, we decided to take a break and spend a day in nature. 
The communication with the local agency was excellent. Matias, the local agent, greeted us with a nice message and we felt he was a reliable company.
The Caminito del Rey is spectacular, be careful if you have vertigo!
author: JenCarPer

title: amazing trip
text:
Beautiful day walking through the Andalusian landscape, full of rock and olive tree. 
The trip Granada - Caminito del Rey takes only 2 hours. It was fast and enjoyable.
Once there, we started the trail: almost 3h enjoying, walking on the river and the rock. When we finished, our driver, very punctual and polite, was waiting for us on the other side of the trail. Undoubtedly a great choice.
author: cristobalr285

title: Caminito del rey
text:
As a nature lover, I could not leave Spain without visiting the Caminito del Rey. The communication with the agency was fast and fluid. Matias was a great travel agent.
The trail is spectacular, adapted to all ages.
author: anaaH9771GQ

title: A must-see in Malaga
text:
Spectacular trail in the heart of Andalucia. We had an extra day in Granada and decided to invest it in visiting the trail “El Caminito del Rey”. What a great choice! we chose the guided option. It is in a group, but we all take an audio guide to listen to the guide's explanations. It's interesting as you walk, and the time is the same. 
All in all, don't miss this trail on your trip to southern Spain!
author: kimberlyhT664JG
